notes.title: Memory Lost: Chapter One Receives Huge Content Update!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a massive update to Memory Lost: Chapter One! You can now play the entire first chapter of the full game by heading to Memory Lost: Chapter One  and jumping straight into the fresh, updated gameplay and seeing what’s in store for the full launch next year!

[previewyoutube=rvGlwLCvWfc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Memory Lost: Chapter One  was first launched in December 2022 and has delighted shooter fans with its innovative combat mechanics and fast-paced gameplay. Over the past 12 months, we’ve been gathering community and players feedback to support the ongoing development of the full game. As part of the continued development journey of Memory Lost, we will continue to use the valuable feedback gathered from the Memory Lost: Chapter One to enhance the full game experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

Try Chapter One for free and wishlist Memory Lost!

notes.title: TETRAGON RECEIVED RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Friends, fans of puzzles, secrets and mysterious worlds!

We are pleased to announce that the dizzying anti-gravity adventure Tetragon  has received a release date - 12 August!

An amazing story about the adventures of a simple lumberjack Lucius, traveling across picturesque square worlds in search of his son, who suddenly disappeared under mysterious circumstances, is about to become available to everyone.

[previewyoutube=42fcJfiuFBg;full][/previewyoutube]

Do not forget to add the game to your wishlist and please all your friends with this wonderful news:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545850/Tetragon/
You can also try out the game right now as part of a free demo!

notes.title: First update for game is rolling out!
notes.notes:
Through your feedback and reviews on Steam and in social media we found and fixed some issues in Red Comrades.

 Major improvements in 1.0 version:

Main menu bug fixes and improvements:
- Added Save anywhere and anytime feature
- Added separate sound and music volume level adjust sliders
- Fixed selecting resolution on two or more displays issue 

Item and inventory bug fixes:
 - Fixed game items incorrect appearing and disappearing
 - Fixed multiply using of the same items
 - Fixed incorrect items descriptions and tips
 - Added new interactive objects

Sound problems:
- Fixed sound and music not hearing in some of the cutscenes and dialogs 
- Fixed some dialog lines being mixed up

And much more!

Thank you for helping us make this well received adventure even better! Have a nice play!
